parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The name of the IP address whitelist group.    
It must be 2 to 32 characters in length, start with a lowercase letter, end with a lowercase letter or digit, and contain only lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_).

parameters.name: SecurityIpGroupName
parameters.description: The information of the deleted IP whitelist group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun oceanbasepro delete-security-ip-group --instance-id ob317v4uif0000 --security-ip-group-name paytest --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun oceanbasepro DeleteSecurityIpGroup --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId ob317v4uif0000 --SecurityIpGroupName paytest
